talents.e: Gives Flash of Light, Holy Light and Light's Vigil a {14|70}% chance to keep casting time when you take damage.
Increases your Strength by {2|10}%.
Increases healing from Holy Light, Flash of Light and Holy Shock by {4|12}%.
Lets {15|30}% of your mana regeneration continue while casting.
Increases damage from your Seals and Judgements by {3|15}%.
Cuts Cleanse and Purify mana costs by {10|20}% and Exorcism and Holy Wrath cooldowns by {17|33}%.
Your next Flash of Light, Holy Light or Holy Shock is a guaranteed crit.
Crit heals from Flash of Light, Holy Light, Light's Vigil or Holy Shock have a {20|100}% chance to restore 50% of the spell's base mana.
Reduces mana costs of Consecration, Holy Wrath, Exorcism and Hammer of Wrath by {20|40}%.
Increases Holy spell hit chance by {4|8}% and reduces Silence duration on you by {10|20}%.
Holy Shock and Flash of Light crits cut the cast time of your next Holy Light within 15 sec by {0.5|1} sec.
Bind one ally for 5 min; your Holy Light, Flash of Light and Holy Shock heal them for more.
Increases your Holy spell damage by {5|10}% against the first 4 enemies entering your Consecration.
Instant Holy blast that damages an enemy or heals an ally.
Increases Holy Shock critical strike chance by {15|30}% on allies not affected by your Oath of Light.
Increases the critical strike healing bonus of your Holy spells by {10|50}%.
Your next Holy Shock on the target has no cooldown and also heals the party.
Increases your total Intellect by {2|10}%.
Damaging melee hits have a 10% chance to raise your block chance by {6|30}% for 10 sec or 5 blocks.
Improves your chance to hit by {1|3}%.
Reduces Blessing of Protection cooldown by {1|2} min and increases Blessing of Freedom duration by {3|6} sec.
Reduces Divine Shield, Divine Protection and Templar's Bulwark cooldowns by {30|60} sec and Forbearance duration by {5|10} sec.
8-sec shield that absorbs up to your max health. Causes Forbearance.
Reduces Hammer of Justice cooldown by {5|15} sec.
Increases shield absorb by {15|30}%; blocks have a {50|100}% chance to restore 4% max mana, once every 3 sec.
Increases your armor from items by {2|10}%.
Judge with your active Seal without using it up. 1 min cooldown.
Reduces all damage taken by {3|9}% while Righteous Fury is active.
Increases your Defense Skill by {4|20}.
Reduces Stun and Charm durations on you by {10|20}%.
+30% block chance for 10 sec; each block deals Holy damage. 4 charges.
Blocks give a {8|40}% chance and non-periodic crits a {20|100}% chance for an extra attack; stores up to 4, once per 1.5 sec.
Increases Holy Strike threat by {10|30}%; with Righteous Fury, reduces damage taken by {2|6}% for 6 sec.
Holy Strike cooldown 4 sec shorter, and it triggers your shield talents without spending charges.
Increases your Parry chance by {1|5}%.
Reduces the mana cost of all instant cast spells and abilities by {2|10}%.
Reduces Judgement cooldown by {1|2} sec.
Improves critical strike chance for all spells and attacks by {2|6}%.
Judgement has a {33|100}% chance to return {20|60}% of the judged Seal's mana cost.
Melee hits can lower the target's Strength and Agility by 5% for 10 sec.
Reduces Fear and Disorient durations on you by {15|30}%.
Judgement deals Holy damage, much more to stunned or incapacitated targets.
Increases movement and mounted speed by {8|15}%; does not stack with other speed effects.
Crit damage against you returns {5|10}% to the attacker, capped at 50% of your total health.
Holy Strike deals 20% more and refreshes your Judgements on the target.
Increases physical damage by {2|6}% and reduces threat by {7|20}% with a two-handed weapon equipped.
Reduces Turn Undead cast time by {0.5|1} sec and cooldown by {5|10} sec, and lets it affect Demons.
Incapacitates a humanoid for up to 6 sec; damage breaks it.
Increases physical and Holy damage by {1|3}% for 30 sec after non-periodic crits, stacking up to 3 times.
Adds up to {12|60}% of your Intellect to spell damage and reduces Hammer of Wrath cast time by {0.2|1} sec.
Melee hits store your active Seal for 15 sec, up to 3 stacks.
